_doc: PR2: furniture drawn by an imported model (src/assets.cpp furnitureModelFor): asset id -> its model block (src / dir / scale / offset / yaw / lodDist ...; "_ref": notes). The asset keeps its parts as colliders and stand-ins (shown while the bake is missing; its envelope, broken remains and fragments). Baked by --import-weapon-models like any model. docs/furniture-change-requests.md.
